Some #49ers roster thoughts/questions now that preseason is (basically) over: - Can they live with Carver Willis growing pains early? It sure seems like he's got the inside track on the LG job. There's potential there but there will be bumps along the way. If Robert Jones is back soon, still wonder if he begins the year as starter with Willis waiting in the wings. - Who starts at DT next to Osa Odighizuwa? It's been an uninspiring camp/preseason for Collins and West. There are injury related reasons for both but still fair to wonder what they have there. There will be plenty of options for third down (White/Williams can kick inside) but early downs, they need someone to hold up against the run. West showed some of that late last year and they want Collins to take a step. Haven't seen it yet. James Thompson Jr. and Gracen Halton have some juice but obviously green. - The LB pecking order is tough to decipher. Warner, Greenlaw are obvious. Dugger, too. It seems Wallow has carved out a role and Bethune is still in the mix but there's a lot to figure out given injuries to Nick Martin and Luke Gifford. - Posed the question the other day but is Drake Nugent the backup C? Brett Toth still not back from concussion, Nugent has had a solid camp. Have to have someone who can handle the job. - Is there enough at safety? Still a lot of questions there and though Malik Mustapha has been doing a lot of running on the side (and was getting his GPS checked as recently as Tuesday), that competition never really formed. An improved pass rush would help them but this spot, DT and LG are still biggest questions on the roster when it comes to starters, IMO.
